name: auto-pipeline
description: Agent pipeline rules, scripts, agents, skills and a startup quiz gate for any repo

language.title: Basic: Language
language.description: Language to talk to you in, e.g. en, zh, ms. Code, file names and rule text stay English.

runtime.title: Basic: Runtime
runtime.description: How this machine runs agents. auto works it out, orca uses Orca terminals, plain and cloud use subagents only.

auto_update.title: Basic: Auto update
auto_update.description: Install a newer auto-pipeline by itself at the next start. Off: you run claude plugin update yourself.

main_manager.title: Models: Main manager model
main_manager.description: Model and effort of the main manager. Floor: Opus 5.5 or above, or any Fable, effort medium or above.

task_manager.title: Models: Task manager model
task_manager.description: Model and effort of a task manager. Floor: Opus 5.5 or above, or any Fable, effort medium or above.

reviewer_model.title: Models: Reviewer model
reviewer_model.description: Model and effort of the reviewer of every diff. Floor: Opus 5.5 or above, or any Fable, effort medium or above.

helper_model.title: Models: Helper model
helper_model.description: Model and effort of the fast-lane deputy, the merge deputy and every worker. Form: model-name:effort.

max_usage_percent.title: Load: Max memory %
max_usage_percent.description: How much RAM or CPU may be used before agents wait. Whole number, 1 to 100.

permission_mode.title: Permissions: Permission mode
permission_mode.description: How much an agent may do without asking. bypassPermissions asks nothing; auto lets the model judge.

auto_resume.title: Permissions: Auto resume
auto_resume.description: Resume the agents that were running by themselves when a main manager starts.

todo_before_agent.title: Rules: Todo before agent
todo_before_agent.description: On: a launch naming no open todo task is refused. Off: launches are only recorded on the board.

working_branch.title: Flow: Working branch
working_branch.description: Branch that tasks merge into; init creates it and a worktree for it. The production branch (users) stays apart.

watch_quiet_min.title: Stuck: Consider stuck after (min)
watch_quiet_min.description: Minutes a running task's state file may stay unchanged before the board marks it not confirmed. 1 to 240.

housekeep_interval_min.title: Stuck: Tidy every (min)
housekeep_interval_min.description: Minutes between housekeep passes that tidy leftovers. 0 = off. Whole number, 0 to 1440.

city_port.title: City: City port
city_port.description: Port the agent city listens on, on 127.0.0.1 only. Whole number, 1024 to 65535.

city_idle_min.title: City: City auto close (min)
city_idle_min.description: Minutes the agent city keeps running with no browser open, then it stops by itself. 1 to 240.
